'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Tom Frafjord LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Tom Fafjord/Frafjord 'Chewbacca goes to worlds' Future/Wookiee; Klor'slug (V).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Frafjord]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See / Careful For What You Wish For (V)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
